title: Unlock the Power of Your Influence
coreMove: Real influence starts when you drop the demand for a fast result, model the change yourself, ask honest questions, give space, and cheer the first small step.

exampleSpecs.audience: Junia and readers facing aBC Loop
exampleSpecs.stakes: Repeated positive modeling can influence without pressure.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show Junia using ABC Loop in the source case without controlling another person.
